details: The global crypto economy contracted by a minimal 1.6% to $9.4 trillion in the 12 months ending June 30, 2026, despite a significant $2.1 trillion (50%) decline in market capitalization. This resilience was attributed to a surge in stablecoin flows and peer-to-peer transfers, with Brazil leading the 2026 global crypto adoption index.
title: Crypto Economy Resilient Despite $2.1T Market Cap Drop

details: A Visa survey revealed that 56% of Americans would be inclined to use stablecoins if they offered bank-level fraud protection and deposit insurance, a notable increase from 36%. However, 56% of respondents are still unfamiliar with stablecoins.
title: Visa Survey Shows Rising Stablecoin Adoption Intent with Bank Protections

details: Galaxy Digital has added $100 million of Sky Protocol's sUSDS stablecoin to its corporate treasury and approved it as collateral for its institutional trading business. The firm also purchased an undisclosed amount of SKY tokens, signaling deeper lending ties with Sky Protocol.
title: Galaxy Digital Boosts Treasury with $100M sUSDS, Acquires SKY Tokens

details: CME Group plans to introduce standard and Micro futures contracts for Bitcoin Cash (BCH) and Uniswap (UNI) on October 19, pending regulatory approval. This expansion further broadens CME's suite of crypto derivatives, offering more institutional avenues for altcoin exposure.
title: CME Group to Launch Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures

details: SoFi has initiated the settlement of debit and credit card transactions using its SoFiUSD stablecoin on Mastercard's global payments network. This program is projected to process over $25 billion in annualized volume, making SoFi the first bank to enable stablecoin settlement across Mastercard.
title: SoFi Integrates Stablecoin Settlement on Mastercard Network

details: Blockchain.com and the New York Stock Exchange are collaborating to provide access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs. This partnership will see NYSE's parent company, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Data Services, distribute Blockchain.com's crypto market data, while Blockchain.com will integrate ICE and NYSE data feeds into its app for its extensive user base.
title: Blockchain.com and NYSE Partner for Tokenized US Stocks/ETFs Access

details: The total cryptocurrency market capitalization briefly reclaimed the $3 trillion mark following a broad rally across Bitcoin and altcoins. Concurrently, open interest in perpetual futures soared to nearly $160 billion, the highest since October 2025, indicating increased leverage. In the past 24 hours, $300 million in crypto positions were liquidated, with $139 million in long and $161 million in short positions.
title: Crypto Market Cap Reaches $3T Amid High Leverage; $300M Liquidated
